s1.desc: an empty space with a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: a snowy plain under a bright sky with fluffy clouds

s3.desc: a dining area with a round cream table and wooden chairs, drawn on a plain pale grey background

s4.desc: a bedroom drawn on a plain pale grey background

beats.text: Pax and Polly stand side by side holding flippers and wave their free flippers in the air
Pax and Polly lift their joined flippers high and Polly twirls around beneath them
Pax and Polly stand side by side with their joined flippers raised, smiling
Polly leans in and kisses Pax on the cheek as a red heart pops up above them and Pax blushes
Pax and Polly stand holding flippers with blushing cheeks while the heart fades away

spans.notes: Design note for the whole skit: the leads have amber-orange beaks and feet with a darker orange underside (feet ~RGB 240,160,48 / 208,96,32) and a slightly deeper blue Pax (~96,144,224), flat white faces; not the OLD_DESIGN yellow beak/feet or periwinkle gradient look, so curated as on style. Camera locked: fully plain ground; compare 0/45 both shadows overlap exactly (feet stay planted). No caption or watermark (top third and bottom fifth bare on every 10th frame)

spans.view: with a red checkered picnic blanket holding a plate of cookies and two mugs

beats.text: Polly pours tea from a teapot into a mug while Pax sits beside her on the blanket holding a cookie
Polly lifts the steaming mug in one flipper and the teapot in the other while Pax watches, holding his cookie
Polly hands the mug of tea to Pax, who leans over to take it
Pax sips from the mug while Polly holds the teapot up and waves her other flipper

spans.notes: camera locked: compare 46/110 blanket, horizon, ice marks and clouds black/unchanged (motion bands on sky and snow have too little texture; compare decides). spans.view: with bowls of noodle soup and plates of sushi rolls on the table

beats.text: Pax tips a big bowl up to his face and gulps it down, droplets flying, while Polly eats from her bowl
Pax sets the bowl down and pops the sushi rolls from his plate into his beak one after another
Pax chews with his eyes closed and a flipper at his beak while Polly slurps a long strand of noodles
Pax turns his eyes to Polly, still chewing, while she keeps slurping noodles from her fork

spans.notes: camera locked: ECC on the table pedestal band (y 0.64-0.76, x 0.25-0.75) within 0.5 px, scale 1.0001, cc 1.000; compare 111/170 table, chairs and shadow black. A small seashell sticker on Pax's chair leg (prop). No caption or watermark

spans.view: with a double bed between two nightstands with lamps and an alarm clock, the room dim

beats.text: Pax sleeps curled on his side under the covers beside the glowing alarm clock on the nightstand
Pax rubs his eye, rolls onto his back and stretches both flippers up as he wakes
Polly, a sleep mask pushed up on her head, climbs onto the bed from the right and slides under the covers beside Pax
Pax and Polly lie close under the covers gazing at each other, until Polly shuts her eyes and leans in
Pax and Polly nuzzle cheeks under the covers with their eyes closed
Polly opens her eyes and looks ahead while Pax, his eyes still shut, eases back from her cheek
Pax turns over and reaches out to tap the alarm clock on the nightstand while Polly watches
Pax hops out of bed while Polly pulls her sleep mask down and sinks under the covers
Pax waddles off to the left while Polly lies tucked under the covers with only her masked head showing

spans.notes: steady dim lighting through the whole shot (ground ~RGB 178,190,195), kept with time night; the alarm clock shows an early-morning time. Camera locked: ECC on the footboard band (y 0.72-0.95) scale 1.0000, <= 0.2 px, cc 1.000; compare 171/265 bed, lamps and nightstands black. Polly comes in at the right edge f192 already wearing the mask; she pulls it over her eyes ~f242. Pax leaves past the left edge, last sliver f257. beats.text: Pax stands with a flipper at his beak looking unsure while Polly clasps her flippers and giggles
Pax leans over to Polly and wraps his flippers around her
Pax holds Polly in a hug, leaning his face close to hers while she looks up at him
Pax kisses Polly on the cheek while she shuts her eyes with a happy smile
Pax lets go and stands beside Polly smiling while she keeps her eyes closed, blissful
Pax reaches out a flipper and Polly clasps it in both of hers with a shy smile
